appendix_title: ŚĀKTA TANTRAS IN FOUR DIVISIONS (according to Vairocana's Pratiṣṭhā-lakṣaṇa-sara-samuccaya)

divisions.note: The numbering in the original text skips from 9 to 11.

content.citation: (cf. also Mark Dyczkowski: The canon of the Śaivāgama and the Kubjikā-Tantras of the Western Kaula Tradition, Delhi: Motilal Banarsidas, 1989, pp. 34-35)

summary: This appendix presents a classification of Śākta Tantras into four divisions, corresponding to the four cardinal directions. The system is attributed to Vairocana's 'Pratiṣṭhā-lakṣaṇa-sara-samuccaya'. The divisions are I. Garuḍa (East) with 28 tantras, II. Vāma (North) with 23 tantras (numbered 1-24 with a skip), III. Dakṣiṇa (South) with 32 tantras, and IV. Bhūta (West) with 20 tantras. The appendix concludes with a reference to a work by Mark Dyczkowski for further study.
purpose: The purpose of this appendix is to provide a specific, structured list of Śākta Tantras as categorized in a particular textual tradition, namely Vairocana's Pratiṣṭhā-lakṣaṇa-sara-samuccaya. It serves as a scholarly reference for the organization and nomenclature of tantric literature.
key_information: The appendix lists Śākta Tantras based on Vairocana's 'Pratiṣṭhā-lakṣaṇa-sara-samuccaya'.
The classification is structured into four divisions associated with cardinal directions: Garuḍa (East), Vāma (North), Dakṣiṇa (South), and Bhūta (West).
The Vāma division lists 23 tantras (though numbered up to 24, number 10 is missing).
A citation is provided for Mark Dyczkowski's 'The canon of the Śaivāgama and the Kubjikā-Tantras of the Western Kaula Tradition' for comparative information.

tables_and_data.description: A classification of Śākta Tantras into four numbered lists, each representing a division associated with a cardinal direction.
tables_and_data.data_summary: The appendix enumerates a total of 103 tantras across four divisions: Garuḍa (East) with 28 tantras, Vāma (North) with 23 tantras, Dakṣiṇa (South) with 32 tantras, and Bhūta (West) with 20 tantras. Each entry consists of a number and the name of a tantra.
